core_obligations: Descend the defining ideal (proof lines 3032-3044): by definition the given morphism is the blowing up of the spectrum of the completion in a closed subscheme defined by an ideal whose vanishing locus is the closed point; since the completion is Noetherian that ideal contains a power of the extended maximal ideal, and because the quotient of the completion by the powers of the extended maximal ideal agrees with the corresponding quotient of the base, the ideal is the extension of an ideal of the base containing the same power of the maximal ideal.

Base change the blowing up (proof lines 3044-3050): blowing up the base in that ideal produces an admissible blowup with respect to the punctured spectrum, and flatness of the completion identifies its base change with the given morphism over the completion.
proof_roadmap: Descend the ideal defining the given admissible blowup through the comparison of the quotients by the powers of the maximal ideal.
Blow up the base in the descended ideal.
Use flat base change of blowing up to identify the base change with the given morphism.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that every admissible blowup of the spectrum of the completion of a Noetherian local ring with respect to the punctured spectrum is the base change of an admissible blowup of the spectrum of the ring (statement lines 3028-3033). The proof (proof lines 3034-3050) descends the defining ideal using the comparison of quotients by powers of the maximal ideal and applies flat base change of blowing up. H2: a complete short argument.
